text: Closed production optimizer epic after completing the remaining AC-420-01/09 public-policy gap. RigidOptimizerControl now composes validated RigidSamplingPolicy, RigidRobustLoss, RigidConvergencePolicy, RigidDampingPolicy, RigidCapturePolicy, and RigidExecutionPolicy values. Dense Huber LM/GN is the documented default; information-aware sampling requires a validated RigidStencilControl; squared loss and reference coordinate search are explicit; only deterministic serial pair reduction is supported, with frame-level parallelism using separate workspaces. The policies are executable: a shared test compiles an 8-sample/8-bin information-aware stencil and proves squared versus Huber changes the measured objective. Current gates: 428 aggregate tests/82 current reports, 40 JVM motion, 37 development Scala.js motion, 37 FullOpt Node motion, and 4 registration tests per platform, all green. Six-DOF recovery remains 0.001716758 mm/0.043979019 deg at unchanged gates; allocations remain 88 B for the primitive 512/32768-sample kernel and 211,696 B for the nontrivial 11-scan fit. Architecture/protocol validators pass with 148 PRD IDs, 27 nodes/86 DAG edges, 563 public names/56 canonical owners, and protocol SHA 660a1bfcc01199a911031bcd080875862d56727f541aa74adb6f75e6d01ea087. Evidence is uncommitted-worktree development evidence, not a superiority or release claim.
